headline: Indian Markets Open Under Pressure Amid Rising Oil Prices, Tech Selloff, and New RBI Currency Regulations

marketStatus.message: Market is open for trading today.

why: Escalating Middle East tensions have pushed Brent crude prices near $106 per barrel
A selloff in technology stocks and weak global cues are weighing on domestic investor sentiment
RBI has tightened rules on rupee non-deliverable contracts and widened cash reserve requirements
Persistent concerns over inflation and significant foreign fund outflows continue to impact the market
whatHappening: Airtel Money experienced a weak debut on the London market, impacting sentiment for its parent company
Asset Management Company (AMC) stocks have recorded gains of up to 33% in H1 FY27 despite market turmoil
HD Fire Protect IPO has opened its first day of subscription with focus on GMP and expected listing gains
The Sensex and Nifty are tracking Gift Nifty cues following a 548-point drop in the previous trading session
summary: The Indian stock market is trading with a negative bias as Brent crude prices approach $106 amid geopolitical tensions. Investors are also processing new RBI restrictions on rupee contracts and a selloff in the technology sector. While AMC stocks show resilience, the broader market remains cautious following significant losses in the previous session.
